definitions.gloss: cautionary note; warning notice; written warning; instructions
definitions.explanation: A written notice or label that warns about dangers, restrictions, or important information that the reader should be aware of.

examples.japanese: {注意書|ちゅういが}きをよく{読|よ}んでください。
examples.english: Please read the cautionary notes carefully.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}の{注意書|ちゅういが}きに{副作用|ふくさよう}のことが{書|か}いてあった。
examples.english: The warning notice on the medicine mentioned side effects.

examples.japanese: {製品|せいひん}の{注意書|ちゅういが}きを{無視|むし}して{使|つか}うと、{事故|じこ}につながることがある。
examples.english: Ignoring the product warnings when using it can lead to accidents.

notes:
A compound of {注意|ちゅうい} (caution/attention) and {書|が}き (writing/notation). Found on product packaging, medicine labels, signs, contracts, and various documents. Common in everyday Japanese life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意書|ちゅういが}きを{読|よ}む: to read the warning notice
- {注意書|ちゅういが}きに{従|したが}う: to follow the instructions/warnings
- {注意書|ちゅういが}きを{確認|かくにん}する: to check the cautionary notes
- {注意書|ちゅういが}きを{添|そ}える: to attach a cautionary note

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {警告|けいこく}: warning — stronger, more urgent
- {但|ただ}し{書|が}き: proviso, stipulation — a qualifying clause in a legal or official document
- {取扱説明書|とりあつかいせつめいしょ}: instruction manual — comprehensive product instructions
